signals.title: Según los informes, los ingresos de OpenAI son $ 20 mil millones menos de lo proyectado anteriormente
signals.summary: Se había informado que los ingresos anuales del laboratorio de IA rondaban los 70 mil millones de dólares, pero un nuevo informe indica que son mucho menores.
signals.title_orig: OpenAI’s revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
signals.summary_orig: It had previously been reported that the AI lab's annualized revenue was some $70 billion, but a new report claims it's a whole lot less than that.

signals.title: Google lleva la IA auténtica a Gemini, empezando por las empresas
signals.summary: Google convierte a Gemini en un agente de IA que planifica, ejecuta tareas, colabora con apps empresariales, delega a subagentes y tiene su propia identidad y correo.
signals.title_orig: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
signals.summary_orig: Google is turning Gemini into an AI agent that can plan, execute tasks, and work across business apps and systems. The agent can delegate work to subagents, use multiple AI models, and even gets its own workplace identity, complete with an email address.

signals.title: Antrópico cambia la política de uso para prohibir el abuso de modelos y la interferencia electoral
signals.summary: La nueva política de uso de Anthropic prohíbe abusos extremos a Claude, pero permite críticas, y también regula interferencia electoral, campañas engañosas, armas y vigilancia.
signals.title_orig: Anthropic changes usage policy to ban model abuse and election interference
signals.summary_orig: Anthropic's updated usage policy explicitly prohibits users from repeatedly abusing Claude in extreme cases, though ordinary frustration and criticism are still allowed. The new rules also address election interference, deceptive campaigns, weapons software, and surveillance.

signals.title: Las soluciones matemáticas de OpenAI aún no cumplen con los estándares del campo

signals.title_orig: OpenAI’s math solutions aren’t meeting the field’s standards yet
